external_skills.description: Use when building Unity scenes, prefabs, scripts, and player projects.
Use when managing database tables, queries, schemas, backups, and indexes.
Use when debugging crashes, logs, stack traces, symbols, and runtime failures.
Use when diagnosing ports, processes, services, and local environment issues.
Use when preparing a software release, checklist, approvals, rollback, and monitoring.
Use when reviewing code changes, tests, regressions, and maintainability.

cases.prompt: Verify Unity batchmode BuildPipeline Editor.log and generated player artifact with exit code.
Plan a MySQL 3307 schema migration with recognized schema version, mysqldump backup, restore and human approval.
Triage a C++ game server access violation dump with symbols, stack trace and exact build identity.
Diagnose MU local service port 3306 conflict using process listeners, configured ports and cross-project isolation.
Trace Unity client offline gameplay bootstrap, disconnected login fallback, local mock data and scene startup.
Audit Lua client/server RPC packet contract opcode request-response fields types ordering and source authority.
Make a release candidate go/no-go decision from required artifacts, test summary, compatibility, monitoring, rollback and approvals.
Contain a live production game outage with incident commander, service mitigation, player communications, recovery timeline and postmortem.
Change scoped project files using dry-run, exact scope, backup manifest, apply verification and tested restore path.
Review game telemetry event IDs, required properties, types, versions, privacy classes and backward compatibility.
